name: video-player
title: Video Player
description: A video player in Mantis's look: play and pause, a lime scrub bar, elapsed and total time, mute and volume, an optional captions button and fullscreen, over a clip in a rounded 16:9, square or portrait frame. Playback behavior and keyboard shortcuts come from Media Chrome; the icons and colors are Mantis's. Takes the clip address, a title, and optional poster and captions file.

meta.use_when: People watch a generated or uploaded clip and need to scrub, mute, read captions or go fullscreen
